append_only_correction.rule: Do not rewrite the source design artifact after implementation. Record the completed implementation as a later receipt.

successful_steps: Verify legacy TRUMP loader still accepts additive manifest

integrated_mechanics.EXACT_HINDSIGHT_GUARD: An exact state/action pair with a recorded verified-failure receipt can be rejected as REJECT_KNOWN_BAD.
integrated_mechanics.ANTI_COMPLEMENT_FALLACY: A neighboring or unseen action returns NOT_KNOWN_BAD, never PROVED_GOOD.
integrated_mechanics.TWO_FACE_FREEZE: LEARNING_FACE may append lessons before freeze; THEOREM_FACE rejects post-hoc learning after freeze.
integrated_mechanics.NO_HOTEL_CALIFORNIA: Macro progress requires strict descent of a non-negative polynomially capped rank; equal/increasing/out-of-cap rank is rejected.
integrated_mechanics.DEBT_FAIL_CLOSED: Configured work/byte debt bounds are charged and overflow is rejected without mutating the accepted ledger state.
integrated_mechanics.NO_UNBOUNDED_HISTORY_ADVICE: The theorem candidate may not treat an ever-growing life-history archive as free non-uniform advice.

current_theorem_frontier.name: HINDSIGHT_COVERAGE_AND_REMAINDER_LEMMA
current_theorem_frontier.statement: For every reachable nonterminal theorem-state S of one frozen arbitrary-CNF algorithm, polynomial-time guard evaluation plus canonical candidate enumeration leaves and finds at least one exact useful action within one original-N polynomial budget.
current_theorem_frontier.why_it_is_now_central: The runtime can remember exact certified dead routes and reject non-progress, but exclusion of known bad routes does not establish universal existence or polynomial discovery of a good remainder.
